title: Which Ancient Civilization Matches Your Spirit?
description: Travel back in time and discover which ancient civilization reflects your inner spirit!

rome.title: Roman Empire 🏛️
rome.description: You're a natural leader with a strategic mind. Like Rome, you value structure, discipline, and building lasting legacies. You're ambitious and know how to bring people together to achieve great things. Your strength lies in organization and perseverance—you're in it for the long haul.

egypt.title: Ancient Egypt 🐍
egypt.description: You possess timeless wisdom and a deep appreciation for mystery. Like Egypt, you're drawn to the profound and the eternal. You value knowledge, spirituality, and leaving your mark on the world. Your creative expression is legendary, and you have a keen eye for beauty and symbolism.

greece.title: Ancient Greece ⚡
greece.description: You're a philosopher at heart with a love for ideas and debate. Like Greece, you cherish democracy, art, and the pursuit of knowledge. Your creativity and intellectual curiosity drive you to explore new concepts. You believe in the power of the mind and the beauty of expression.

japan.title: Ancient Japan 🌸
japan.description: You embody harmony, discipline, and deep respect for tradition. Like ancient Japan, you find beauty in simplicity and mindfulness. You balance modern thinking with ancient wisdom, always seeking inner peace and mastery. Your patience and attention to detail are unmatched.

mayan.title: Mayan Civilization 🌟
mayan.description: You're ahead of your time with a visionary perspective. Like the Maya, you have a deep connection to astronomy, time, and the cosmos. You're innovative and not afraid to think differently. Your spiritual depth and understanding of cycles make you uniquely wise.

viking.title: Viking Realm ⚔️
viking.description: You're bold, adventurous, and fiercely loyal. Like the Vikings, you value courage and freedom above all. You're not afraid to explore the unknown and take calculated risks. Your practical strength and determination help you overcome any obstacle life throws your way.
